record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.context_brief: Quantised response to a classical symmetry
record.original_question: Suppose a classical model has a Poisson bracket {·,·}_P and an infinitesimal symmetry Q that acts nontrivially on that Poisson structure. After quantisation, must there always be a corresponding well-defined response either on the Hilbert space of states, on the operator algebra of observables, or on both?

evidence.quote: Problem 16. For a given infinitesimal symmetry Q ∈ sym{·, ·}_P which acts nontrivially on the Poisson structure {·, ·}_P in a given classical model, so that Q({·, ·}_P) ≢ 0, is there always a well-defined post-quantisation response in either or both the Hilbert space of states or the operator algebra of observables ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let a classical mechanical model be specified by a smooth Poisson manifold (M, {·,·}_P), and let Q be an infinitesimal symmetry of the underlying dynamics that acts nontrivially on the Poisson bracket itself, in the sense that the Lie derivative Q({·,·}_P) ≢ 0 (so Q belongs to sym{·,·}_P but is not a Poisson vector field). Consider any quantisation of this model, consisting of a Hilbert space H of states together with an associative (typically noncommutative) algebra A of operator-valued observables that deforms the Poisson algebra of classical observables.

Question: Must there always exist a well-defined "post-quantisation response" to the classical symmetry Q — that is, a canonically associated action or transformation induced by Q on the Hilbert space H, on the operator algebra A, or on both — corresponding to the classical action of Q on {·,·}_P?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as Problem 16 in a list of open problems concerning Kontsevich graph constructions of Poisson bracket symmetries; no resolution appears in the literature, and the question of how nontrivial classical Poisson symmetries lift through quantisation remains a general open issue.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 16. For a given infinitesimal symmetry Q acting nontrivially on the Poisson structure, is there always a well-defined post-quantisation response on the Hilbert space or operator algebra?
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an unresolved open problem.
